zh.title: Garmin表示Autoland已配備於逾2,500架飛機
zh.summary: Garmin表示Autoland已配備逾2,500架飛機，並涵蓋超過15種機型
body: Garmin於2026年10月14日表示，目前已有超過2,500架飛機配備Garmin Autoland。該公司表示，這項技術自2020年5月首次取得認證後略逾六年，目前已可用於超過15種機型。
Garmin指出，Autoland今年獲認證可納入HondaJet Elite II、Embraer Phenom 300EV、Pilatus PC-12 PRO及Epic E1000 AX；前兩款機型的認證，代表Autoland首次可用於雙發噴射機。系統會計算前往最適合機場的飛行路徑、避開地形與惡劣天氣，並啟動穩定進場後降落。

en.title: Garmin says Autoland is now installed on more than 2,500 aircraft
en.summary: Garmin says Autoland now equips more than 2,500 aircraft across over 15 models.
body: Garmin said on October 14, 2026, that more than 2,500 aircraft now feature Garmin Autoland. The company said the system, initially certified in May 2020, is now available on more than 15 aircraft models.

Garmin said Autoland was certified for incorporation on the HondaJet Elite II, Embraer Phenom 300EV, Pilatus PC-12 PRO and Epic E1000 AX this year. The HondaJet Elite II and Phenom 300EV certifications marked its first availability on twin-engine jets. The system calculates a flight path to a suitable airport while avoiding terrain and adverse weather, then initiates a stabilized runway approach and lands the aircraft.

zh.title: 貝爾完成首具MV-75短艙結構 並展開齒輪箱測試
zh.summary: 貝爾完成首具MV-75短艙結構，並開始測試齒輪箱；首架測試機仍在組裝中。
body: 貝爾（Bell）已完成美國陸軍MV-75 Cheyenne傾轉旋翼機的首批短艙結構，並開始測試該機的齒輪箱。這兩項進展均與首架MV-75測試機有關。
根據AeroTime報導，首批短艙結構已運抵位於德州阿馬裏洛（Amarillo）的貝爾組裝中心，工作人員已開始將其與機翼結合。貝爾表示，其在設計、工具、製造與組裝過程中使用數位工程。
報導指出，貝爾於2026年6月完成首批兩具MV-75機翼結構時，短艙仍在組裝。機翼與短艙後續將與在堪薩斯州威奇托（Wichita）組裝中心建造的機身結合。
貝爾也已開始測試MV-75的齒輪箱，該齒輪箱驅動引擎與短艙的發電機、液壓泵與冷卻鼓風機。齒輪與外殼在德州沃斯堡（Fort Worth）的貝爾製造技術中心生產，測試則在其位於德州大草原城（Grand Prairie）的新設MV-75傳動系統測試實驗室進行。報導指出，該設施於2023年動工。
動力與推進系統的其他零組件來自外部供應商。報導指出，柯林斯航太（Collins Aerospace）於2026年4月獲選提供主發電與互連傳動系統，勞斯萊斯（Rolls-Royce）則於2025年12月開始對MV-75的AE 1107F引擎進行地面測試。
在德州阿靈頓（Arlington）的貝爾武器系統整合實驗室，工程師正在整合MV-75的飛控電腦、通用用途電腦、致動器驅動單元、電氣零組件與大面積顯示器。貝爾於2024年3月啟用該設施，用於在裝機前測試軟體與機上系統。
美國陸軍飛行員也協助調整座艙。2026年5月，第101戰鬥航空旅的飛行員在阿拉巴馬州紅石兵工廠（Redstone Arsenal）以模擬機評估MV-75的飛行員顯示器，重點在於其對飛行員工作負荷的影響；其回饋預計將用於該機的細部設計。貝爾表示，最新進展使首架MV-75測試機更接近完成，但尚未公佈飛行測試時程。

en.title: Bell completes first MV-75 nacelle structures and begins gearbox testing
en.summary: Bell completed the first MV-75 nacelle structures and started gearbox testing; the first test aircraft is still being assembled.
body: Bell has completed the first nacelle structures for the US Army's MV-75 Cheyenne tiltrotor and has begun testing the aircraft's gearboxes. Both milestones concern the first MV-75 test aircraft, being built under the US Army's Future Long-Range Assault Aircraft (FLRAA) program.

According to AeroTime, the first nacelle structures have arrived at Bell's Amarillo Assembly Center in Texas, where workers have begun mating them with the aircraft's wings. Bell credited its use of digital engineering throughout design, tooling, manufacturing and assembly.

The report states that when Bell completed the first two MV-75 wing structures in June 2026, the nacelles were still being assembled. The wings and nacelles are then due to be joined with the fuselage under construction at Bell's Wichita Assembly Center in Kansas.

Bell has also begun testing the MV-75's gearboxes, which drive the electrical generators, hydraulic pumps and cooling blowers for the engines and nacelles. The gears and housings were produced at Bell's Manufacturing Technology Center in Fort Worth, Texas, while testing is taking place at its new MV-75 Drive System Test Lab in Grand Prairie, Texas. Construction of the facility began in 2023, according to the report.

Other components of the power and propulsion system come from outside suppliers. The report states that Collins Aerospace was selected in April 2026 to provide the main power generation and interconnect drive systems, while Rolls-Royce began ground testing the MV-75's AE 1107F engines in December 2025.

At Bell's Weapon System Integration Lab in Arlington, Texas, engineers are integrating the MV-75's flight control computers, general purpose computers, actuator drive unit, electrical components and large area displays. Bell opened the facility in March 2024 to test software and onboard systems before installing them on the aircraft.

US Army pilots are also helping refine the cockpit. In May 2026, aviators from the 101st Combat Aviation Brigade evaluated the MV-75's pilot displays in simulators at Redstone Arsenal, Alabama, focusing on their effect on pilot workload; their feedback is expected to inform the aircraft's detailed design. Bell said the latest progress brings the first MV-75 test aircraft closer to completion, although a timeline for flight testing has yet to be announced.

zh.title: 新加坡航空11月起推全艙等機上用品，商務艙首供睡衣套裝
zh.summary: 新加坡航空11月起推出全艙等新用品，商務艙首次提供睡衣套裝
body: 新加坡航空表示，將自2026年11月起在所有艙等推出新的機上用品。新用品將逐步配置於飛行時間超過6小時的航班；睡衣套裝則預計提供於所有長程航班，以及部分飛行時間超過6小時的中程夜間航班。
商務艙乘客將首次獲提供睡衣套裝。新商務艙備品包由Byredo提供。豪華經濟艙乘客將收到以回收材料製作的拉鍊袋，採用新加坡航空 batik 圖樣，並附有手腕帶。

en.title: Singapore Airlines plans new cabin amenities from November, including Business Class sleepwear
en.summary: Singapore Airlines plans cabin-wide amenity changes from November, with Business Class sleeper suits.
body: Singapore Airlines (SIA) says it will introduce new in-flight amenities across all cabin classes from November 2026. The new kits are to be rolled out gradually on flights longer than six hours. Sleeper suits are planned for all long-haul flights and selected medium-haul overnight flights lasting more than six hours.

Business Class passengers will be offered sleeper suits for the first time. The cabin’s new amenity kit comes from Byredo. Premium Economy passengers will receive a zip pouch made from recycled materials, featuring SIA’s batik motif and a hand strap.

zh.title: BIRD完成Global 7500防飛彈系統安裝並獲EASA認證
zh.summary: BIRD完成Global 7500防飛彈系統安裝並獲EASA認證
body: BIRD Aerosystems已在龐巴迪 Global 7500上完成Airborne Missile Protection System（AMPS）安裝，並取得歐洲聯盟航空安全局（EASA）認證。Ondas於2026年10月13日公佈這項認證。
據Ondas說明，認證確認該系統在Global 7500上的整合符合適用的歐洲適航要求，可納入飛機的認證構型。AMPS包含定向紅外線反制系統（DIRCM）；來源指出，這套雷射系統可幹擾熱尋標飛彈的尋標器。

en.title: BIRD completes Global 7500 missile-defense installation and EASA certification
en.summary: BIRD Aerosystems completes AMPS installation and EASA certification on a Bombardier Global 7500.
body: BIRD Aerosystems has completed installation of its Airborne Missile Protection System (AMPS) on a Bombardier Global 7500 and received European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) certification. Ondas announced the certification on October 13, 2026.

According to Ondas, the approval confirms that the system’s integration on the Global 7500 meets applicable European airworthiness requirements and allows the protection system to form part of the aircraft’s certified configuration. The suite incorporates directional infrared countermeasures (DIRCM), described in the report as a laser-based system that jams the seekers of heat-seeking missiles.

zh.title: 印度航空波音787因安全疑慮轉降齋浦爾
zh.summary: 印度航空AI2030班機因安全疑慮轉降齋浦爾，完成檢查後重新登機
body: 印度航空AI2030班機於10月14日執行法蘭克福至德里航班，途中發出可能遭劫持警示後轉降齋浦爾。報導指出，該班機由波音787-9執飛，並於齋浦爾安全降落。
印度航空表示，班機因感知到安全疑慮而轉降。相關安全單位完成檢查並放行飛機與機組員；乘客下機接受安全檢查，之後重新登機。報導指出，飛機約於當地時間09:35（UTC 04:05）降落。7500警示需要調查，但訊號本身不能證明劫持已發生。

en.title: Air India Boeing 787 diverts to Jaipur after perceived security concern
en.summary: Air India flight AI2030 diverted to Jaipur; checks cleared the aircraft and crew.
body: Air India flight AI2030 was operating from Frankfurt to Delhi on 14 October aboard a Boeing 787-9. The aircraft diverted to Jaipur after sending an alert for a possible hijacking and landed safely at about 09:35 local time (04:05 UTC), according to the report.

Air India described the diversion as following a perceived security concern. The airline said security agencies checked and cleared the aircraft and crew. Passengers were disembarked, underwent security checks and later reboarded. The report notes that a 7500 alert demands investigation but does not prove that a hijacking occurred.
